html:
Which season is the most beautiful in Ha Long is a concern for tourists who come to Ha Long for the first time, so you will ask the question of which season is the most beautiful in Ha Long and what is the interesting experience on the cruise, so let’s find out more about the Ha Long cruise experience below.

According to Vietlook’s Ha Long travel experience, the best time to go on a Ha Long cruise is in spring and autumn, that is, from April to October, at this time the weather in Ha Long is quite nice without rain, so it is very convenient for tourists to visit and experience on luxurious 5-star boats to admire the peaceful sea scenery.

Ha Long has a tropical climate, hot and humid summers and cold winters, and the temperature will fluctuate according to each season, and Ha Long is also a suitable place to participate in sea activities such as: Swimming, kayaking, snorkeling, playing volleyball…

Especially when experiencing Ha Long cruise, visitors will enjoy the cool breeze, while gliding on the clear blue sea. Although the best time for visitors to participate in Ha Long cruise tours is summer, Ha Long winter weather is quite low, and you should not go during the rainy and stormy seasons as it will affect your tour.

However, if you do not like the crowds like in the summer, you can experience Ha Long cruise in the winter, and you proactively book a schedule with the boat house in advance so that your trip is most convenient, if you want to register for a budget Ha Long tour, you should go in the winter, because at this time the services are often lower than in the summer, the peak season.

So no matter what season of the year you choose, Ha Long still brings you its own beauty and the best experiences.

So to have the most perfect trip, please refer to the weather in Ha Long in the year.

Ha Long in January

The sunny weather is very suitable for foreign tourists to come and see the scenery on the bay, at this time the temperature is relatively cool at around 18 degrees Celsius, the weather is less rainy but there is fog, visitors should bring a thin jacket.

If you travel to Ha Long in January, visitors can visit Bai Tho mountain, from above to see the bay’s famous sights from above, because Ha Long in January the weather is not suitable for visitors to participate in underwater activities.

February

The temperature is lower than January, around 17 degrees Celsius, this is the Lunar New Year holiday, and some attractions on the bay are closed because the weather is quite cold. If you come to Ha Long, you are only suitable for resort tours at luxury resorts to admire the scenery from above.

March

The temperature gradually warms up, the sky is clear, sometimes there is drizzle, the temperature is around 19 degrees Celsius, very suitable for those who like climbing mountains, conquering heights.

April

Ha Long in April is the summer season, the temperature gradually increases and fluctuates around 24 degrees Celsius, this is the best time for you to participate in rowing games, paragliding, mountain climbing, sightseeing… and it is also the occasion of the 30/4 holiday, so many tourists choose Ha Long tourism as a stopover during their vacation.

May

Ha Long in May is the summer season, the temperature increases, the hot weather is very suitable for tourists to experience the cruise, and you should bring a swimsuit for convenient swimming.

June

Ha Long weather in June is summer, and the rainy season begins, although there is not much rain, visitors need to monitor the weather before coming to Ha Long.

In July and August, Ha Long still has showers and storms, and the amount of rain is quite high, so visitors need to monitor the weather before coming to Ha Long.

In September and October, Ha Long enters autumn, however, sudden showers still appear, but gradually decrease, the autumn weather in Ha Long is quite beautiful, visitors can participate in games on the sea or choose interesting resort tours.

In November and December, Ha Long enters the dry season, this is also the peak season of Ha Long, the sky is clear and there is no rain, and at the end of December, the temperature gradually turns to winter, so there is gentle sunlight, visitors can sip a cup of coffee and admire the poetic sea and island scenery.
